description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer component in the Rialto client, using Google Test framework. It tests creation, failure scenarios, and registration of WebAudioPlayer objects.

classes.name: RialtoClientCreateWebAudioPlayerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudioPlayer creation tests, inherits from WebAudioPlayerTestBase.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Test that a WebAudioPlayer object can be created successfully.

methods.name: CreateWebAudioPlayerIpcFailure
methods.description: Test that creation throws an exception if createWebAudioPlayerIpc returns nullptr.

methods.name: CreateWebAudioPlayerRegisterFailure
methods.description: Test that creation throws an exception if registerClient returns false.
